root_cause: The optional projected-lineup path treated MLB schedule hydrate homePlayers/awayPlayers arrays as batting orders and allowed them to reach lineup certainty, expected-PA, confidence, and simulation inputs. Those arrays were not bound to a T-minus-4 receipt, an official active-roster receipt, a fitted joint lineup artifact, or an approved probability-consumption map.

affected_scope.probability_path: DailyPredictor.predict(use_projected_lineups=True) -> feature bundles -> LineupIntelligence -> expected PA and simulation/confidence metadata

safe_remediation.source_boundary: The public MLB API path now rejects schedule-hydrated projected lineups before cache or network use.
safe_remediation.probability_boundary: DailyPredictor now rejects unbound projected-lineup mode before feature construction, preventing direct callers or mock substitutes from bypassing the source guard.
safe_remediation.coverage_behavior: Missing confirmed lineups remain explicit coverage losses. No last-lineup, roster, league-average, clipped, or hand-tuned substitute is supplied.
safe_remediation.future_enablement: Only a separately certified integration that validates the existing projected-lineup contract and its receipt-bound fitted joint distribution may enable projected probabilities.

regression_and_mutation_proof.source_mutation: Requesting schedule projected lineups raises before network access.
regression_and_mutation_proof.probability_mutation: Requesting projected mode through DailyPredictor raises before the feature builder calls the source.
regression_and_mutation_proof.confirmed_non_regression: Confirmed-lineup daily predictor, run-slate, market-authorization-scope, and frozen shared-PA tests continue to pass.
regression_and_mutation_proof.test_result: 43 passed across focused contract/source/probability and related confirmed-lineup suites

artifact_hashes.data_and_feature_artifacts: None rebuilt. No historical or prospective lineup, price, prediction, or outcome artifact was read, rewritten, or backfilled.

single_highest_value_next_action: Collect prospective active-roster receipts under the running collector, then build a receipt-bound historical lineup-feature store and predeclare a fitted joint-lineup candidate before any projected-lineup probability path is enabled.
